mapper.select: SELECT c.seller_name AS sellerName, c.marketplace AS marketplace, COUNT(*) AS hitCount, ROUND(AVG(c.price), 2) AS avgPrice, ( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(c2.node_label_path, ':', -1) FROM competitor_products_clean c2 WHERE c2.marketplace = c.marketplace AND c2.seller_name = c.seller_name AND c2.m01_active = 1 AND c2.node_label_path IS NOT NULL AND c2.node_label_path != '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(c2.node_label_path, ':', -1) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS topCategory FROM competitor_products_clean c WHERE c.marketplace = #{marketplace} AND c.m01_active = 1 AND c.seller_name IS NOT NULL AND c.seller_name != '' GROUP BY c.seller_name, c.marketplace HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minCount} ORDER BY hitCount DESC, avgPrice ASC LIMIT #{limit}
